{{include reference="JIRA.JIRAConfigMacros"/}} {{velocity}} ## Lists, saves and deletes the JIRA instances defined in JIRA.JIRAConfig, for the JIRA administration section ## (JIRA.JIRAConfigSheet). ## * Without an "action" parameter: the instances, in the format of the live table results (used as the result page of ## the Live Data of the administration section). ## * POST action=save: creates (no "number" parameter) or updates (the "number" of the instance object, which must still ## have the "previousId" ID) an instance from the "id", "url", "deploymentType" (kept when the parameter is missing) ## and "authenticationType" parameters. ## * POST action=delete: deletes the instance object with the given "number" and "id". ## The authentication settings of the instances are saved by the page of their authentication type (see the ## org.xwiki.contrib.jira.authconfig UIX extension point), not here. #set ($configClassName = 'JIRA.JIRAConfigClass') #set ($configDoc = $xwiki.getDocument('JIRA.JIRAConfig')) ## #macro (jiraConfigError $status $message) #set ($discard = $response.setStatus($status)) #jsonResponse({'error': $message}) #end ## ## Sets $instance: the instance object with the number given in the request, if any. #macro (jiraConfigGetInstance) #set ($instance = $NULL) #set ($instanceNumber = $numbertool.toNumber($request.number)) #if ("$!instanceNumber" != '') #set ($instance = $configDoc.getObject($configClassName, $instanceNumber.intValue())) #end #end ## #macro (jiraConfigLink $cssClass $label $content $instance) $content## #end ## ## Sets $matches: whether the given value matches the Live Data filter of the given property, sent with the live table ## results parameters: the values (""), how they're matched ("_match": partial, prefix, exact or ## empty, where the value is ignored; the deployment and authentication types are matched exactly) and whether all or ## any of them have to match ("/join_mode": AND or OR). #macro (jiraConfigMatchesFilter $property $value) #set ($matches = true) #set ($filterValues = $request.getParameterValues($property)) #if ($filterValues && $filterValues.size() > 0) #set ($joinModeParameter = "${property}/join_mode") #set ($matchAny = "$!request.getParameter($joinModeParameter)" == 'OR') #set ($matchTypeParameter = "${property}_match") #set ($matchTypes = $request.getParameterValues($matchTypeParameter)) #set ($matches = !$matchAny) #set ($lowerCaseValue = "$!value.toLowerCase()") #foreach ($filterValue in $filterValues) #set ($lowerCaseFilterValue = "$!filterValue.toLowerCase()") #set ($matchType = 'partial') #if ($matchTypes && $matchTypes.size() >= $foreach.count) #set ($matchType = $matchTypes.get($foreach.index)) #end #if ($matchType != 'empty' && ($property == 'deploymentType' || $property == 'authenticationType')) #set ($matchType = 'exact') #end #if ($matchType == 'empty') #set ($valueMatches = $lowerCaseValue == '') #elseif ($matchType == 'exact') #set ($valueMatches = $lowerCaseValue == $lowerCaseFilterValue) #elseif ($matchType == 'prefix') #set ($valueMatches = $lowerCaseValue.startsWith($lowerCaseFilterValue)) #else #set ($valueMatches = $lowerCaseValue.contains($lowerCaseFilterValue)) #end #if ($matchAny && $valueMatches) #set ($matches = true) #elseif (!$matchAny && !$valueMatches) #set ($matches = false) #end #end #end #end ## #macro (jiraConfigInstances) #jiraConfigDeploymentTypeLabels #jiraConfigAuthenticationTypes #set ($instances = []) #foreach ($instance in $configDoc.getObjects($configClassName)) ## Deleted objects leave a null in the list. #if ("$!instance" != '') ## Data Center is stored as an empty deployment type. #set ($filterDeploymentType = "$!instance.getValue('deploymentType')") #if ($filterDeploymentType == '') #set ($filterDeploymentType = 'datacenter') #end #set ($filterAuthenticationType = "$!instance.getValue('authenticationType')") #if ($filterAuthenticationType == '') #set ($filterAuthenticationType = 'noAuth') #end #set ($included = true) #foreach ($filter in [['id', "$!instance.getValue('id')"], ['url', "$!instance.getValue('url')"], ['deploymentType', $filterDeploymentType], ['authenticationType', $filterAuthenticationType]]) #jiraConfigMatchesFilter($filter.get(0) $filter.get(1)) #if (!$matches) #set ($included = false) #end #end #if ($included) #set ($discard = $instances.add($instance)) #end #end #end ## The live table offset starts at 1. #set ($offset = $numbertool.toNumber($request.offset).intValue()) #if (!$offset || $offset < 1) #set ($offset = 1) #end #set ($limit = $numbertool.toNumber($request.limit).intValue()) #if (!$limit || $limit < 1) #set ($limit = 15) #end #set ($editLabel = $services.localization.render('jira.config.instances.edit')) #set ($deleteLabel = $services.localization.render('jira.config.instances.delete')) #set ($rows = []) #foreach ($instance in $instances) #if ($foreach.count >= $offset && $rows.size() < $limit) #set ($id = "$!instance.getValue('id')") #set ($url = "$!instance.getValue('url')") #set ($deploymentType = "$!instance.getValue('deploymentType')") #set ($authenticationType = "$!instance.getValue('authenticationType')") #if ($authenticationType == '') #set ($authenticationType = 'noAuth') #end ## The ID opens the edit form too. An instance without ID can't be used, but is listed so that it can be fixed or ## deleted. #if ($id != '') #set ($idContent = $escapetool.xml($id)) #else #set ($idContent = "$escapetool.xml($services.localization.render('jira.config.instances.noId'))") #end #set ($idHTML = "#jiraConfigLink('jira-instance-edit' $editLabel $idContent $instance)") ## Only link to web addresses. #set ($lowerCaseURL = $url.toLowerCase()) #if ($lowerCaseURL.startsWith('http://') || $lowerCaseURL.startsWith('https://')) #set ($urlAttributes = "class='jira-instance-url' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'") #set ($urlHTML = "$escapetool.xml($url)") #else ## Not an empty string, which the Live Data displays as missing. #set ($urlHTML = "$escapetool.xml($url)") #end #set ($deploymentTypeLabel = $jiraDeploymentTypeLabels.get($deploymentType)) #if ("$!deploymentTypeLabel" == '') #set ($deploymentTypeLabel = $services.localization.render('jira.config.deploymentType.unavailable')) #end #set ($authenticationTypeLabel = $jiraAuthenticationTypeLabels.get($authenticationType)) #if ("$!authenticationTypeLabel" == '') #set ($authenticationTypeLabel = $services.localization.render('jira.config.authType.unavailable')) #end #set ($editIcon = $services.icon.renderHTML('pencil')) #set ($deleteIcon = $services.icon.renderHTML('cross')) #set ($actionsHTML = "
## #jiraConfigLink('action jira-instance-edit' $editLabel $editIcon $instance)## #jiraConfigLink('action jira-instance-delete' $deleteLabel $deleteIcon $instance)
") #set ($discard = $rows.add({ 'id': $idHTML, 'deploymentType': $escapetool.xml($deploymentTypeLabel), 'url': $urlHTML, 'authenticationType': $escapetool.xml($authenticationTypeLabel), 'actions': $actionsHTML })) #end #end #jsonResponse({ 'totalrows': $instances.size(), 'returnedrows': $rows.size(), 'offset': $offset, 'reqNo': $numbertool.toNumber($request.reqNo).intValue(), 'rows': $rows }) #end ## #macro (jiraConfigSaveInstance) #jiraConfigGetInstance #set ($id = $stringtool.trimToEmpty($request.id)) #set ($url = $stringtool.trimToEmpty($request.url)) #set ($lowerCaseURL = $url.toLowerCase()) #if ("$!request.number" != '' && "$!instance" == '') #jiraConfigError(404, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.notFound')) #elseif ("$!instance" != '' && $stringtool.trimToEmpty($instance.getValue('id')) != $stringtool.trimToEmpty($request.previousId)) ## The object was given to another instance since the form was opened (e.g. the instance was deleted, then another ## one was added): don't overwrite it. #jiraConfigError(409, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.modified')) #elseif ($id == '') #jiraConfigError(400, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.idRequired')) #elseif (!$lowerCaseURL.startsWith('http://') && !$lowerCaseURL.startsWith('https://')) #jiraConfigError(400, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.urlInvalid')) #else ## The ID identifies the instance in the macros and its authentication settings: it must be unique. #set ($duplicate = false) #foreach ($other in $configDoc.getObjects($configClassName)) #if ("$!other" != '' && ("$!instance" == '' || $other.number != $instance.number) && $stringtool.trimToEmpty($other.getValue('id')) == $id) #set ($duplicate = true) #end #end #if ($duplicate) #jiraConfigError(400, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.idExists', [$id])) #else #if ("$!instance" == '') #set ($instance = $configDoc.newObject($configClassName)) #end #set ($discard = $instance.set('id', $id)) #set ($discard = $instance.set('url', $url)) ## The deployment type isn't sent when it isn't displayed: keep the current one. #if ($request.getParameter('deploymentType') != $NULL) #set ($discard = $instance.set('deploymentType', $request.getParameter('deploymentType'))) #end #set ($authenticationType = "$!request.authenticationType") #if ($authenticationType == '') #set ($authenticationType = 'noAuth') #end #set ($discard = $instance.set('authenticationType', $authenticationType)) #set ($discard = $configDoc.save("Saved the JIRA instance [$id]")) #jsonResponse({'number': $instance.number, 'id': $id}) #end #end #end ## #macro (jiraConfigDeleteInstance) #jiraConfigGetInstance ## Check the ID too, in case the instance was replaced since the list was displayed. #if ("$!instance" == '' || "$!instance.getValue('id')" != "$!request.id") #jiraConfigError(404, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.notFound')) #else #set ($discard = $configDoc.removeObject($instance)) #set ($discard = $configDoc.save("Deleted the JIRA instance [$!request.id]")) #jsonResponse({'id': "$!request.id"}) #end #end ## #if (!$xwiki.hasAdminRights()) #jiraConfigError(403, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.notAllowed')) #elseif ("$!request.action" == '') #jiraConfigInstances #elseif ($request.method != 'POST' || !$services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.form_token)) #jiraConfigError(403, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.invalidRequest')) #elseif ($request.action == 'save') #jiraConfigSaveInstance #elseif ($request.action == 'delete') #jiraConfigDeleteInstance #else #jiraConfigError(400, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.invalidRequest')) #end {{/velocity}}
